title: ENDOSYMBIOSIS  ingest Stalwart, RustDesk, Giscus as OUR cyanobacteria, chloroplast, mitochondria.

do_not_reinvent.already: /data/subsystems-endosymbiosis.json  Python-in-Rust is mitochondria. JS-in-HTML is chloroplast. THAT map stays.
do_not_reinvent.this_file: a SECOND swallow. free-living Rust/open orgs into the eco cell. Margulis recursive: the product becomes a new row.

the_swallow.host: the eco  eukaryote. primals are the nucleus.
the_swallow.not: fork them. not digest them. merge. they keep their own DNA (their repo, their license, their process).
the_swallow.tonight: name the organelle. do not force the swallow. RustDesk is already inside. Stalwart is at the mouth. Giscus still swims.

organelles.name: RustDesk
organelles.is: MITOCHONDRIA  already inside. ports answer. ATP = presence, hands on a screen.
organelles.and: own process, own ports, own repo. double membrane: their binary + our mesh.
organelles.now: cannot yank it without losing the inner face. still divides as their release, not ours.

organelles.name: Stalwart
organelles.is: CHLOROPLAST  not yet captured. draft config is the food vacuole. photosynthesis = mail from light (a write becomes sugar).
organelles.and: own DNA: stalwartlabs/stalwart. we do not rewrite it.
organelles.now: engulf later. Proton is the rented sunlight until the plastid works.

organelles.name: Giscus
organelles.was: and still is CYANOBACTERIA  free-living on GitHub.
organelles.is: the ancestor that has not been swallowed. comments as free oxygen.
organelles.and: their login, their DNA. we only offer a membrane.
organelles.now: firm later. do not force a plastid tonight.

rule: endosymbiosis is ingest, not hire. they stay first class. we stay the host. BearDog is the nuclear genome that may later hold some of their keys  not today.
